parent_objective: run a larger no-training promoted-base source-rich public wave to test whether M1373 sparse wrong-history positives repeat
blocked_by: M1374 audits M1373 as structurally clean but source-positive evidence remains one-seed sparse
supersedes: using private holdout before public source-rich scaling
claiming source-diverse proof from the M1373 smoke

public_gates: M1375 must run the promoted M1362 base through the larger public capability-step source wave
M1375 must keep actor inputs and checkpoint parameters unchanged
M1375 must produce source-rich scenario, pair, intervention, accepted, reset-only, rejected, and model-fidelity artifacts
M1375 must keep private holdout unused
M1375 must interpret accepted-row sparsity using the pre-registered thresholds
forbidden_shortcuts: do not mutate the candidate checkpoint
do not relax source-positive thresholds after results
do not claim true high-fidelity per-wheel physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs larger public source-rich wave for promoted M1362 base after a structurally clean but sparse smoke
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public source-rich wave only; no promotion, private holdout, PPO, high-fidelity, L0/L1/L2/L3, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source-rich artifacts are missing or malformed
stop if checkpoint or actor parameters change
stop if private holdout is used
stop if source-positive thresholds are changed after seeing results
fallback_plan: if source-positive thresholds pass, route to source-rich result audit before objective or training
if accepted rows remain sparse, route to retargeted source/intervention audit
if accepted rows are zero but reset-only is high, route to temporal/sequence intervention design
if both accepted and reset-only signals are low, route to source-distribution redesign
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1374 admits a larger public source-rich wave after M1373 sparse smoke

admission_evidence: M1373 finds two accepted wrong-history rows but only one accepted seed
M1374 routes to larger public source-rich wave before training or private holdout
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: scenario, snapshot, and matched-pair counts are positive
checkpoint and actor contract are unchanged
accepted and reset-only signals are classified by pre-registered thresholds

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1375 can expose source-rich history sensitivity but cannot alone prove level3 anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: normal, wrong-history, and reset-history source-rich interventions are recorded
accepted wrong-history rows and reset-only rows are interpreted separately

self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: promoted M1362 base under larger M991 capability-step public source wave.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If accepted rows remain sparse or zero, record the result and route to temporal/sequence or source-distribution redesign instead of threshold relaxation.
allowed_claims: source-rich public wave artifact and metric result
no promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level, L0/L1/L2/L3, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A larger promoted-base public source-rich wave can determine whether the sparse M1373 wrong-history positives repeat under fresh broader coverage.
success_criteria: accepted and reset-only row counts are reported against pre-registered interpretation thresholds
failure_criteria: summary or core CSV artifacts are missing
scenario_count, snapshot_count, or matched_pair_count is zero
actor parameters or actor inputs change
training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout occurs

commands.name: source_rich_public_wave
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.extreme_dynamics_scenario_corpus --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m991_capability_step_fault_source_wave.json --pairing-mode cross_fault --seed-start 137500 --seed-count 256 --device auto --run-dir runs/m1375_promoted_base_source_rich_public_wave

decision_rule: M1375 passes as a public source-rich wave if it produces clean no-training cross-fault artifacts with unchanged actor/checkpoint contract and reports accepted/reset-only signals against the pre-registered thresholds.
